items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Phil Woods did a tour with a big band starting in Spain for a guy named Jordi Pujol

ctx.x: Some of them. Pete Christlieb for sure.

Okay. So we’re going to do one night in London with a small band and the next night with Bill Holman’s band, he’s going to use us who are in the band anyway and supplement it with English players. And then he’s going — Phil Woods did a tour with a big band starting in Spain for a guy named Jordi Pujol who’s a booker over there. He’s a friend of Jordi Sunol, who has Fresh Sounds records. I may have those last names mixed up, but anyway we’ve got about five or six dates over there with Bill’s band over there. I…
Yeah. You do your own booking? Your own business?
